_source: Recorded-shape fixtures written from Synthetic's official Search documentation (https://dev.synthetic.new/docs/synthetic/search, read 2026-10-20). Success follows its results array with title, url, text and published; source text and URLs are illustrative. Error bodies are illustrative HTTP outcome probes, not vendor-documented error schemas. Local transmission states are exercised separately. The capability fixture requests an unsupported domain filter.

success.body: {"results":[{"title":"Example Article","url":"https://example.com/article","text":"A relevant excerpt from the page.","published":"2025-01-23T12:30:00Z"},{"title":"Another Source","url":"https://example.org/source","text":"Another page excerpt.","published":null}]}

bad_request.body: {"error":"quota in an invalid request must not be scanned"}

rate_limited.body: {"error":"quota text is hidden by REST throttling"}
